message: `aria-hidden="true"` on the part may take `warning` out of the accessibility tree
$reason: A warning part with its `status`, written `aria-hidden="true"` on itself: both engines take the element out of the tree with the region (measured on 2026-10-20: Chromium 141 and 155 `ariaHiddenElement`, Firefox 136 and 158 no accessible), and the warning on the screen is announced by nobody. Point 7 read the part's role and not what hides it; a reading that asked only the elements above the part, as one that copied point 9's walk of the ancestors without the element itself would, passed it too.
